notes.title: Catwifhat v0.8.2 - Bug fixes
notes.notes:
- We fixed the problem with unlocking cats in collections (we hope it will work in such a large number of people, but during testing everything worked).

To get the EXP and achievement go into collections and where the cat has a padlock open means you have that cat in your inventory, when you click the padlock you will get the achievement and xp.

Next, we'll deal with the stacking problem.

notes.title: Catwifhat v0.8.1 - Bug fixes
notes.notes:
- We've temporarily disabled the stacking option due to problems with disappearing items
- We've fixed the timer

The problems with collections are caused by the server that handles it, we're in the process of rewriting the code and changing the server.

notes.title: Catwifhat v0.7.1 - Drop Pool Changes + New Itemshop + Cake "2024"
notes.notes:
Hey! In this update we add some cats, change the itemshop, fix bugs with exp display and add a special artifact “Cake (2024)”.

-1 LVL TO EVERYONE:

We are reducing the LVL by 1, because by default when you start the game you have lvl 0, and from level 1 you will get rewards for collecting cats. We want to avoid bots collecting rewards this way.

Drop Pool:

Removed: Prisoner Cat (Common)
Removed: Policeman Cat (Uncommon)
Removed: Zorro Cat (Rare)
Removed: Space Cat (Epic)
Added: Desert Cat (Common)
Added: Grape Cat (Uncommon)
Added: Pufferfish Cat (Uncommon)
Added: Angry Cat (Rare)
Added: Captian Cat (Epic)

Special Artifact "Cake (2024)":

We are adding a special artifact for you for 2024 (sorry to be so late). Until the end of January, you can get a special artifact “Cake (2024)”, which will give a lot of bonuses in future updates in which we will add collections of artifacts, weapons, materials, pet, cosmetics and much more :)

Itemshop:

We are changing the itemshop that we added more than 2 months ago.

Removed: Batman Cat
Removed: Prince Cat
Removed: Midnight Cat
Removed: Background #2
Removed: Background #3
Added: Illuminati Cat
Added: Weeknd Cat
Added: Potter Cat

EXP Refresh Button:

We added an EXP refresh button because not everyone refreshed EXP well, so now you can do it yourself.

In 2 weeks we will add another update in which we will improve many things.

Join our discord so you don't miss a thing

notes.title: Catwifhat v0.2 - Inventory Overhaul & Drop Changes
notes.notes:
Hello! We’re excited to share some important updates in this version of Catwifhat. Here’s what’s new:

INVENTORY:

 Improved loading of your inventory for faster access.
 Pages added in the inventory to fit more items and keep things organized.
 Unique skins will now only show once in your inventory, saving you space and making things tidier!
 
DROP POOLS:

COMMON:

 Removed: Robber Cat
 Removed: Cowboy Cat
 SPECIAL:

 Added: Autumn Cat (Event Cat, available until the end of October!)

DISCORD UPDATES:

 We’ve improved the layout of our Discord server for a smoother experience.
 Polish chat has been added for our Polish-speaking players!
 Discord games like Counting and Akinator are now available.
 Voice chats have been added to hang out and talk with others.
 A new "start" channel will guide you through the server roles and how to unlock them.
 Check out the "self-roles" channel to customize notifications you want to receive and select your region (based on the continent you live on).

Be sure to join our Discord to stay updated!

notes.title: Catwifhat v0.1 - GAME RELEASE
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Today is the day we release our “CATWIFHAT” game! The game is a clicker in which you can get a unique skin for your cat every 3 hours.

The game is free to play and we are not a scam. We want the game to be a game where you collect cats. We want the game to be very developed, but for that we need time! We will provide updates for you regularly up to a couple of weeks on Mondays.

At the very beginning of the game, we have added for you an inventory in which you can change the skin of the cat that you drop.

For those who support us at the very beginning, we have prepared a cat named “OG Cat”, which you can drop for the first 4 days after the start of the game.

For more information see our discord:
https://discord.gg/ZD4r3SumMG
